brownian.interpretation: Quadratic-payoff first-order integral residual; nonzero terminal loss is expected
brownian.noise_convention: The forward process and BSDE martingale use identical Brownian increments

ou.interpretation: Four-dimensional unstopped OU analytic calibration; not stopped nonlinear DK

interpretation.learning_or_temporal_convergence: A fixed data/capacity/forward-step study does not establish a convergence rate
interpretation.matched_accuracy_speedup: Not assessed by this artifact summary
interpretation.optimizer_seeds: Separate fits, never pooled as Monte Carlo samples

interpretation.stopping: Every frozen path retained; zero events have a positive probability upper bound
